complete.description: All eligible acquired theorem candidates have dispositions. Does not certify discovery of all paper theorems or supporting extensions.

candidate_universe_scope.description: Eligible checked theorems in acquired Lean metadata, including any explicit supplementary roster. Historical absence has the same bounded meaning; no paper-wide discovery credit.

report_home.description: 7: proof-strategy deviation; 8: reusable proof technique. Neither grants supplementary theorem credit.

title: Shared-reference result classification with a separate proof-relationship lane (v3)

source_error_evidence.description: Private source-error demonstration, reviewed within the relationship assessment. A replacement proof alone is insufficient.

corrigendum_evidence.description: Actual author corrigendum material, using the existing source-only evidence descriptor. Typed byte-pinned artifacts must be supplied to the relationship reviewer; the reviewer establishes authorship and relation to the bound source claim, not the internal kind tag.

condition_types.$comment: Tags do not establish provenance, necessity or a source error. Coverage describes taxonomy annotation for one condition, never the complete assumption inventory of a theorem or paper.

qualification_evidence.description: Evidence for this particular premise or material difference, not the entire theorem. Material differences inherit their existing statement/proof scope; premise findings concern the statement, and necessity remains a separate field. A complete mathematical argument differs from a partial one; a source-proof defect alone does not refute its theorem. Absent historical metadata means unassessed, never implicitly confirmed. Internal replacement approval is not an author correction.
